item.title: FramePair 0.3.1
item.description:
# FramePair 0.3.1
- Correct photos that are slightly above or below a built-in or custom aspect ratio by cropping excess pixels or repeating edge pixels to fill a small shortfall; previews and JPEG / PNG exports use the same corrected dimensions - Auto Crop is now named Auto Ratio Correction, with details showing the cropped or added pixels on each affected edge - Remove a source photo using the button at the top-right of its preview; the arrangement picker has its own row

# FramePair 0.3.1
- 接近内置或自定义比例的照片，无论像素略多还是略少，都可通过裁切或边缘像素复制补齐为精确比例；预览与 JPEG / PNG 输出使用一致的校正尺寸 - Auto Crop 更名为「自动比例校正」，详情分别显示各边实际裁切或补齐的像素 - 来源照片的移除按钮固定在预览右上角，处理方式选择器独占一行

item.title: FramePair 0.3
item.description:
FramePair 0.3 focuses on flexible photo arrangements and export preparation:
- Mix multiple arrangements in one batch: Direct keeps one photo as one output; Merge 2 and Merge 3 stack two or three photos vertically; Split divides one wide photo at its visual center into left and right outputs - View candidate photos and merge results together in Merge Photos, replace an individual photo, fill an empty position, and exchange the top and bottom photos - Track pixel dimensions and aspect ratios across source photos, arrangements, and Output Preview - Optionally use Auto Crop to remove a few edge pixels when a photo is only slightly outside a common ratio - Reorder finished arrangements in Output Preview and export them with automatic sequential numbering - Apply a per-file JPEG size limit and review the estimated size and encoding quality before export - Mix JPEG, PNG, and single-image TIFF sources in one batch, then export the batch as JPEG or lossless PNG - Use the interface in English or Simplified Chinese and check for updates from within the application

FramePair 0.3 重点完善多张照片的灵活编排与导出准备：
- 同一批次可混合使用多种处理方式：Direct 保持单张输出；Merge 2 与 Merge 3 分别将两张或三张照片上下拼合；Split 将一张宽图从视觉中心分成左右两张 - Merge Photos 同时显示候选照片与拼合结果，可替换单张照片、回填空缺并交换顶部和底部位置 - 来源照片、编排过程和 Output Preview 持续显示像素尺寸与画面比例 - 可选的 Auto Crop 会移除边缘的少量像素，修正与常见比例只有轻微偏差的照片 - Output Preview 支持拖动调整成片顺序，导出时按照确认后的顺序自动连续编号 - JPEG 输出可设置逐文件大小上限，并在导出前显示预计文件大小和编码质量 - 同一批次可混合导入 JPEG、PNG 与单图 TIFF，并统一导出为 JPEG 或无损 PNG - 界面支持英文与简体中文，并新增应用内更新检查
